JiwaDocument.Name: Shipments - Re-Open a Shipment
JiwaDocument.Description:
This plugin provides a button on the shipment form, called 'Re-Open Shipment'.

Clicking the button would set the status of the shipment that is currently displayed on the shipment form from Closed back to Booking In.

The button is 'greyed out'/inactive unless the current shipment is closed.

Permissions to the button are set by a user group called 'Re-Open Shipment'.
JiwaDocument.Author: Jiwa Financials
